svg.desc: Career prep: study profiles for federal agencies (FBI, CIA, DEA, Secret Service, ATF, DHS). FBI selection process: Simulate the hiring process from Phase 1 through Quantico: written test, written exercise and more.; Law dictionary and case studies: Learn the legal terms and study real federal cases.; Exam prep: Practice for the federal exams before you apply.; Live federal job board: Openings from USAJOBS.gov, right inside the app..
